falcon.name: Falcon
falcon.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 Phoenix Lord or <Craftworld> Infantry models. Each Wraithguard and Wraithblade model takes up the space of 2 other models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models.

wave-serpent.name: Wave Serpent
wave-serpent.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 Phoenix Lord or <Craftworld> Infantry models. Each Wraithguard and Wraithblade model takes up the space of 2 other models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models.

vampire-raider.name: Vampire Raider
vampire-raider.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly Phoenix Lord or Light <Craftworld> models. Wraithguard and Wraithblade models take up the space of 2 other models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly Phoenix Lord or <Craftworld> Infantry models. Each Wraithguard or Wraithblade model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models.

corsair-falcon.name: Corsair Falcon
corsair-falcon.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 <Coterie> Infantry models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models.

corsair-venom.name: Corsair Venom
corsair-venom.transport: This unit can transport up to 5 friendly <Coterie> Infantry models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models.

the-eye-of-wrath.name: The Eye of Wrath
the-eye-of-wrath.text: Once per battle, after this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit within 3" of it and roll one D12; on a 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

bringer-of-the-true-death.name: Bringer of the True Death
bringer-of-the-true-death.text:
Re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit that
target Necrons units.

khaine-awakened.name: Khaine Awakened
khaine-awakened.text: Morale tests taken for friendly Asuryani units are automatically passed whilst they are within 12" of this unit.

the-hand-of-asuryan.name: The Hand of Asuryan
the-hand-of-asuryan.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for friendly Aspect Warrior units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. Add a further 1 to saving throws made for friendly Dire Avengers units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. This cannot improve a saving throw roll beyond 4+.

bladestorm.name: Bladestorm
bladestorm.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit and friendly Dire Avengers units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

brilliant-sun.name: Brilliant Sun
brilliant-sun.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly Aspect Warrior units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. Add a further 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly Swooping Hawks units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

blazing-fury.name: Blazing Fury
blazing-fury.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit and friendly Swooping Hawks units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

fuegan.name: Fuegan
fuegan.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit and friendly Fire Dragon units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

jain-zar.name: Jain Zar
jain-zar.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit and friendly Howling Banshee units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-shadow-hunter.name: The Shadow Hunter
the-shadow-hunter.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit and friendly Striking Scorpion units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

death-by-a-thousand-stings.name: Death by a Thousand Stings
death-by-a-thousand-stings.text: For each attack made by this unit that targets a Light unit, make two attacks instead of one.

spirit-mark.name: Spirit Mark
spirit-mark.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <Craftworld> Spirit Host units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-harvester.name: The Harvester
the-harvester.text: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit and friendly Dark Reaper units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

inescapable-death.name: Inescapable Death
inescapable-death.text: Unmodified hit rolls of 2+ for attacks made with this unit’s ranged weapons are always successful.

legacy-of-altansar.name: Legacy of Altansar
legacy-of-altansar.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit that target Chaos units.

implacable.name: Implacable
implacable.text: This unit can still make a Shoot action in a turn in which it Fell Back.

defence-tactics.name: Defence Tactics
defence-tactics.text: Once per Damage phase, roll one D12 instead of one D6 when making a saving throw for this unit, irrespective of the size of the blast marker.

artillery-battery.name: Artillery Battery
artillery-battery.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

dark-reapers.name: Dark Reapers
dark-reapers.text: Unmodified hit rolls of 3+ for attacks made with this unit’s ranged weapons are always successful.

skyhunters.name: Skyhunters
skyhunters.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made by this unit that target units that can Fly.

exarch-pilot.name: Exarch Pilot
exarch-pilot.text:
If this unit has an Exarch Pilot, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with ranged
weapons by this unit.

path-of-the-shaper.name: Path of the Shaper
path-of-the-shaper.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly <Craftworld> Vehicle or Wraith Construct unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that <Craftworld> Vehicle or Wraith Construct unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

warp-hunter.name: Warp Hunter
warp-hunter.text: Each time this you make a Shoot action with this unit, select either its D-flail (Blast) or D-flail (Rift) to shoot with – you cannot shoot with both in the same Shoot action.

webway-rupture.name: Webway Rupture
webway-rupture.text: When this unit makes a Move action, it can open a rupture in the webway instead of moving. If it does, it is removed from the battlefield and placed into Tactical Reserves. When this unit arrives as reinforcements, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy units. A unit cannot open a rupture in the webway if it was set up on the battlefield this turn, if there are any enemy units in base contact with it, or if there are any blast markers next to it.

the-shade-of-twilight.name: The Shade of Twilight
the-shade-of-twilight.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly Shadow Spectre units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

reaper-of-souls.name: Reaper of Souls
reaper-of-souls.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with ranged weapons by this unit that target Light units.

conclave-of-power.name: Conclave of Power
conclave-of-power.text: If this unit contains 5 or more models, add 2 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit. If this unit contains 10 models, add 4 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit instead

path-of-command.name: Path of Command
path-of-command.text: If this unit is a Warlord, you can secretly choose two orders to issue to this unit’s Detachment instead of one, placing an order marker for each. After all orders are revealed, discard one of those order markers; the Detachment is considered not to have been issued that order.

skyleap.name: Skyleap
skyleap.text: When this unit makes a Move action, it can skyleap instead of moving. If it does, it is removed from the battlefield and placed into Tactical Reserves. When this unit arrives as reinforcements, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy units. A unit cannot skyleap if it was set up on the battlefield this turn, if there are any enemy units in base contact with it, or if there are any blast markers next to it.

warp-jump-generator.name: Warp Jump Generator
warp-jump-generator.text: Instead of making a Move action, this unit can perform a warp jump. If it has any blast markers next to it, you must first resolve damage for it as if it were the Damage phase. If it is not destroyed, remove this unit from the battlefield, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy units and then roll one D12; on a 1, place one blast marker next to this unit.

assured-destruction.name: Assured Destruction
assured-destruction.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit that target Heavy or Super-heavy units.

banshee-mask.name: Banshee Mask
banshee-mask.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

shadow-strike.name: Shadow Strike
shadow-strike.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target units garrisoning a Defensible Terrain feature.

hover-jet.name: Hover Jet
hover-jet.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can declare that this unit will hover. If it does, then until the end of the phase, its Move characteristic changes to 16" but it loses the Supersonic ability.

distortion-fields.name: Distortion Fields
distortion-fields.text: This unit is always an obscured target.

catastrophic-collapse.name: Catastrophic Collapse
catastrophic-collapse.text: In the Damage phase, damage must be resolved for units with this ability before damage is resolved for any other units (including Super-heavy units). If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a D12 for each other unit within 6" of this unit; on a 4+ place two blast markers next to the unit being rolled for.
